role_summary: Own P6 by separating PM evaluation time bases and making noise’s missing deployment context an explicit, recoverable schema state.
recommendation: Do not produce PM or noise scores. Run claim-bound evaluators over the same quality-controlled time series, keeping WHO health-reference comparisons, Korean forecast-band equivalents, local alert-pattern detection, and official government statuses distinct; keep noise visible as blocked until every deployment and measurement requirement is satisfied.
why: A raw PM observation satisfies none of the records’ temporal bases and must remain unclassified.
Sharing an aggregate is safe only when claim_id, purpose, authority, window definition, and lineage remain separate.
A local sensor can show a forecast-band equivalent or alert-like pattern, never an official forecast or alert.
Missing zoning is information, not zero risk; an explicit blocked result prevents default thresholds and silent omission.
sketch:
PM lineage

sensor_observation
  -> derived_aggregate(policy_id, claim_id, window_start, window_end, value, coverage)
  -> evaluation_result(claim_id, status, classification, authority_scope)

For valid observations xi, a policy P defines weights wi, gap handling, alignment, and completeness:
  mean(P,W) = SUM(wi * xi) / SUM(wi)
No mean is evaluable while P's alignment, gap, rounding, or completeness rules are unresolved.

Independent branches

1. WHO 24-hour health reference
   feature = mean(P_WHO_24H, W_24H)
   compare PM2.5 with 15 and PM10 with 45 ug/m3.
   Output: at_or_below_reference | above_reference | pending_window | insufficient_data.
   Label: local 24-hour human-health reference comparison; never crop health or Korean compliance.
   The annual WHO values, PM2.5 5 and PM10 15, require a fourth, calendar-year branch with sufficient coverage.

2. Korean daily forecast-band equivalent
   feature = mean(P_KR_DAY, local calendar day in Asia/Seoul).
   PM10 bands: 0-30, 31-80, 81-150, >=151.
   PM2.5 bands: 0-15, 16-35, 36-75, >=76.
   Because the corpus does not state decimal rounding, rounding_rule remains required metadata. An unfinished day is pending_window, not a real-time grade. Onsite output is labeled local band-equivalent; official_forecast requires an authoritative feed.

3. Korean two-hour sustained pattern
   Hk = mean(P_KR_HOUR, completed hour k).
   candidate(level,k) = (Hk-1 >= threshold[level]) AND (Hk >= threshold[level]).
   PM10 advisory/warning thresholds: 150/300; PM2.5: 75/150 ug/m3.
   Output: no_pattern | one_hour_pending | local_two_hour_pattern | insufficient_data. Only an authoritative feed may produce official_alert_active.

Suggested SQLite core

CREATE TABLE sensor_observation (
  observation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  zone_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  sensor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  metric_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  observed_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  value REAL NOT NULL,
  unit TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind IN
    ('onsite_sensor','official_monitor')),
  quality_flag TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE evaluation_policy (
  policy_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  metric_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  window_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(window_kind IN
    ('fixed_duration','calendar_period','consecutive_fixed_windows')),
  duration_seconds INTEGER,
  subwindow_seconds INTEGER,
  required_subwindows INTEGER,
  alignment TEXT,
  timezone TEXT,
  aggregation_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  gap_policy TEXT,
  minimum_coverage REAL,
  rounding_rule TEXT,
  policy_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(policy_status IN
    ('ready','blocked_policy_pending'))
);

CREATE TABLE derived_aggregate (
  aggregate_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  policy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evaluation_policy(policy_id),
  deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  zone_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  window_start_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  window_end_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  value REAL,
  coverage_fraction REAL,
  aggregate_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(aggregate_status IN
    ('ready','pending_window','insufficient_data'))
);

CREATE TABLE evaluation_requirement (
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  requirement_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  fact_scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(fact_scope IN
    ('deployment','instrument','observation','aggregation_policy')),
  PRIMARY KEY(claim_id, requirement_key)
);

CREATE TABLE deployment_fact (
  deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  fact_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  value_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(value_json)),
  effective_from_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  effective_to_utc TEXT,
  provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
  verified_at_utc TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY(deployment_id, fact_key, effective_from_utc)
);

CREATE TABLE evaluation_result (
  evaluation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  aggregate_id INTEGER REFERENCES derived_aggregate(aggregate_id),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN
    ('evaluated','pending_window','insufficient_data',
     'blocked_missing_metadata','blocked_policy_pending')),
  classification TEXT,
  authority_scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(authority_scope IN
    ('local_reference_comparison','local_pattern','official_status')),
  missing_requirements_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
    CHECK(json_valid(missing_requirements_json)),
  evaluated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL
);

Noise requirements for common-noise-korea-environmental-standard-001:
  deployment: legal_zone_code, roadside_status, measurement_point, effective date
  observation: A_weighting, integration_period_seconds, day_or_night
  instrument: meter_class, calibration status
  policy: evaluation period and completeness rule

Until resolved, return blocked_missing_metadata with the exact missing keys. Once resolved, select exactly one general_area/roadside_area zoning row and compare only compatible LAeq—not instantaneous dB or Lmax.

UI state contract

raw_only: show value, timestamp, origin, and quality; no color grade.
pending_window: show progress and window definition; no inferred classification.
insufficient_data: show coverage/gap failure; never treat missingness as acceptable.
evaluated: show claim-specific label, aggregate, period, and local/official authority.
blocked_missing_metadata: keep axis card visible with a checklist and “No threshold selected.”

score_verdict.what_replaces_it_if_not: Parallel, non-composite status cards: PM raw measurement, WHO 24-hour/annual reference comparison, Korean daily band-equivalent, local two-hour alert-pattern status, official forecast/alert feed, and a noise card that explicitly lists blocking metadata.

brief_corrections: The quarantine file declares 11 reason codes, not eight. The omitted codes are no_significant_effect, site_context_missing, unit_not_transferable, and conference_abstract_only.
PM has three verified records but not a one-record/one-time-base mapping: the WHO record contains both annual and 24-hour means, in addition to Korean daily and hourly-mean-for-two-hours evaluations.
verified_numeric_evidence.json has no explicit temporal_basis field; PM timing is embedded inconsistently in metric, value keys, and Korean measurement_basis prose. The database must normalize it.
The collection contract does not yet require a certified PM grade. It requires storing certification status, grade, and number, while the acceptable certification grade remains unresolved.
procurement_implications: Buy PM instrumentation that reports both PM2.5 and PM10, paired RH/temperature, stable timestamps, raw export, and certification identity/grade; distinguish indoor and outdoor devices.
Retention and clock reliability must support completed hourly, 24-hour, calendar-day, and eventually annual aggregates; exact sampling cadence remains a policy decision.

Noise hardware must produce A-weighted LAeq with recorded integration period plus LAFmax or LASmax with time weighting, meter class, calibrator, and pre/post-calibration records. An instantaneous dB-only device is unusable.
assumptions: Raw timestamped observations will be retained and clocks synchronized.
Indoor, outdoor, onsite, and official data origins can be distinguished.
Aggregation completeness, gap, alignment, and rounding rules genuinely remain undecided.
risks: Multiple honest cards may overwhelm users unless labels are concise.
Low-cost PM bias can make local comparisons misleading despite good lineage.
Strict completeness rules may leave windows pending during outages.
Incorrect or stale zoning metadata could select the wrong noise row.
cheap_validation: Run one fixture-driven SQLite test in under an hour asserting that a high raw sample receives no grade, incomplete daily/24-hour windows remain pending, two completed threshold-level hours produce only local_two_hour_pattern, and noise changes from blocked to one selected row only after verified zoning and roadside facts are inserted.
change_mind_if: I would permit a common numeric axis only if an authoritative source added to the corpus explicitly defines a single sanctioned index across these temporal bases and noise contexts, including aggregation, missing-data, rounding, authority, and instrument-eligibility rules.
